messages:
Nadia: Flagging AegisHealth morning batch spike: p95 token latency increased ~310ms for ~25m (07:50-08:15 UTC). Renewal check in two weeks.
Nadia: From quick replay: non-streaming summaries, median prompt 200 tokens, responses ~150 tokens, bursts from scheduled report generator.
Samir: Any traces or OOMs?
Nadia: No OOMs. Trace shows queue latency jumps when batch >5. Example: [07:55] req x=aa11 model=redwood/secure-v1 seq_in=198 seq_out=152 batch=6 p95=920ms.
Kai: Likely continuous batching cliff + attention kernel boundary. Compact or trimmed models help around these seq lengths.
Nadia: Proposed low-risk plan: 1) enable int8 quant for dedicated pool, 2) canary 12% -> redwood/secure-lite-v1:int8, 3) keep 10% hosted fallback, 4) reduce continuous_batch_size_limit to 48 during window.
Olivia (AegisHealth): We need exactness for clinical wording. Will require an eval on 6 canonical report templates and a QA sign-off.
Samir: Sounds good. We'll run automated diffs (BLEU/ROUGE) + a 1-person human review. Rollback if semantic_score drops >2% or p95 > baseline+200ms for 10m.
Kai: Ops: pre-warm KV cache with top-15 prefixes, set KV-prefetch TTL=70s. Also provision +1 GPU for canary start.
Nadia: Draft route config:
```
route: aegishealth-canary
- match: customer_id == "aegishealth"
- weight: 12
- model: redwood/secure-lite-v1:int8
- pool: dedicated-ah-3
- fallback: hosted
- autoscale_headroom: 0.2
- continuous_batch_size_limit: 48
```
ops-bot: Created canary job aegishealth-canary-4587654321; monitors=p95_tokens,error_rate,semantic_delta; auto-revert if p95>baseline+200ms for 10m OR semantic_delta>2%.
Olivia (AegisHealth): Thanks. Please include our QA and compliance leads on the eval run.
Nadia: Will invite them and attach eval samples. Action items: Nadia prepare eval + invite, Samir run regression and A/B capture, Kai change pool limits + provision GPU, ops-bot monitor + auto-revert.
Nadia: I'll post interim metrics here after 1h of canary. :white_check_mark:
